units.wcis-face-photo.service:
[Unit]
Description=WCIS photo face recognition
After=network-online.target wcis-face-storage.service
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=wcis-face-storage.service

[Service]
Environment=WCIS_PREVIEW_CODEC=h264 WCIS_PREVIEW_SIZE=540
Type=simple
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/python3 /root/wcis-face/candidates/face-camera-ready-20261020/boot_prepare.py
WorkingDirectory=/root/wcis-face/apps/camera-h264-20261030-r2
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -u /root/wcis-face/apps/camera-h264-20261030-r2/serve_photos.py --root /root/wcis-face/releases/20261014-b5a454c11d22 --site /root/wcis-face/apps/camera-h264-20261030-r2/site --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8091 --pl-executable /root/wcis-face/apps/camera-h264-20261030-r2/wcis_face_pl_retained --npu-cache-executable /root/wcis-face/apps/camera-h264-20261030-r2/wcis_face_cached --gallery-store /mnt/wcis-emmc/wcis-face/galleries --gallery-mount /mnt/wcis-emmc --gallery-uuid 67104a06-74a6-4268-a124-269d1b232a28 --camera-owner-executable /root/wcis-face/apps/camera-h264-20261030-r2/wcis_camera_owner --camera-owner-sha256 933c128d5bfccd22782aa775fa0c23c41a6f33d8df29c0713f9e6d27e4ae9eb1 --camera-owner-control /root/wcis-face/candidates/pad-owner-20261026/owner-current.json --camera-owner-fps 30 --camera-native-inputs --camera-pad-bundle /root/wcis-face/candidates/pad-20261018-7d22c90e30
Restart=no
RestartSec=5
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=75
SendSIGKILL=no
Environment=OPENCV_IO_MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS=16000000

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.wcis-sdi-vpu-view.service:
[Unit]
Description=SDI VPU LAN viewer
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/wcis-face/apps/camera-h264-20261030-r2/vpu_live_server.py --control /root/wcis-face/candidates/pad-owner-20261026/owner-current.json --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8092
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.wcis-face-recording.service:
[Unit]
Description=WCIS PS H264/legacy JPEG event recorder (VPU source)
After=network.target wcis-face-photo.service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/wcis-face/candidates/recording-idle-compression-20261031-r1
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/wcis-face/candidates/recording-idle-compression-20261031-r1/recording_service.py --control /root/wcis-face/candidates/pad-owner-20261026/owner-current.json --storage /mnt/wcis-emmc/wcis-face/recordings --mount /mnt/wcis-emmc --uuid 67104a06-74a6-4268-a124-269d1b232a28 --mode off --segment-seconds 60 --quota-mib 4096 --host 0.0.0.0 --backend http://127.0.0.1:8091
Restart=no
TimeoutStopSec=45
MemoryMax=192M
TasksMax=24

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
